name: Forex & Quant Trading
description: Real-time FX tick sensor, Quant VaR modeling, Capital Preservation Risk Manager, and Autonomous Order Dispatcher.

nodes.name: Quantitative Analyst
nodes.taskPrompt: Analyze price action, volume momentum, and portfolio value-at-risk.
nodes.rulePrompt: Reject high-spread slippage anomalies and enforce statistical edge.

nodes.name: Risk Manager
nodes.taskPrompt: Perform capital preservation check, margin audit, and drawdown limits.
nodes.rulePrompt: Never authorize position size exceeding 1.5% portfolio equity.

nodes.name: Trading Director
nodes.taskPrompt: Execute sovereign order routing with dynamic position sizing.
nodes.rulePrompt: Only execute orders with dual risk-manager confirmation.

nodes.name: Risk Escalation Auditor
nodes.taskPrompt: Intervene on high-spread spikes, news volatility, or slippage anomalies.
nodes.rulePrompt: Trigger hedging and margin lock when condition threshold fails.
